notes:
PIT DOMINICANO Route Servers - PEERING Policy

We operate three route servers (BIRDv2) across our sites, supporting RPKI and IRRdb filtering.

RS1: PIT-STI

RS2: PIT-BON

RS3: PIT-SDQ

Redundancy Requirement: For optimal routing, members are requested to peer with at least two (2) route servers.

A. Propagation Management (Large Communities)
Use these communities to control prefix propagation:

Do not advertise to specific AS: 64168:0:Destination_ASN

Advertise ONLY to specific AS: 64168:1:Destination_ASN

Do not advertise to anyone: 64168:0:0

Advertise to all (Default): 64168:1:0

B. Traffic Engineering (AS-PATH Prepend)
Influence inbound traffic by prepending your ASN:

Prepend to ALL: 64168:101:0 (1 hop), 64168:102:0 (2 hops), 64168:103:0 (3 hops)

Prepend to specific AS: 64168:101:ASN (1 hop), 64168:102:ASN (2 hops), 64168:103:ASN (3 hops)

C. Standard Filters (Legacy)
For legacy equipment compatibility:

Block specific AS: 0:ASN_Destination

Block all AS: 0:64168

Allow specific AS: 64168:ASN_Destination
